comments:
Second of three texts in an 88-folio manuscript with continuous folio numbering, listed as a single item in [8H6M69W4], No. 15415. The signature is found on the cover page. The second text is located on fols. 53-54.
See <<Dreyfus and Tsering 2009 [FFQQBB4J]>>.

name: le 'brel pa tshab kyi man ngag
item_description:
Script: 'bru tsha.
The text is divided into two columns rather than written in a single line.
Orthography:
- Palatalization of ma (e.g., myi, myed)
- Alternative prefixes (e.g., rngos for dngos, rgos for dgos)
Use of expressions mirroring the Sanskrit (e.g., buta for buddha, bode for bodhi(sattva)
